name: Electricity-load-forecasting-with-the-Low-Carbon-London-SmartMeter-dataset
what_it_holds: Forecasting notebook/code built on the UK Power Networks 'Low Carbon London' smart-meter dataset (~5,567 London households, half-hourly electricity, Nov 2011-Feb 2014; publicly hosted by UK Power Networks / mirrored on Kaggle). No new data committed here, but confirms the underlying public dataset's continued accessibility.
why_useful: London residential electricity at half-hourly granularity over ~2.5 years is a real, large, free panel; could be tested as a general occupancy/activity baseline against London's Inside Airbnb calendar, though it is whole-household residential, not STR-specific.
time_coverage: Nov 2011 - Feb 2014 (underlying Low Carbon London panel)
size_hint: ~5,567 households, half-hourly (external dataset; this repo is code only)
license: not stated in this repo (underlying dataset UK Power Networks open licence)
themes: Electricity, water and waste data as occupancy proxies (smart-meter open data, tourist-area utility consumption), and mobile-phone tourism statistics (Eurostat MNO experimental)
why_all: London residential electricity at half-hourly granularity over ~2.5 years is a real, large, free panel; could be tested as a general occupancy/activity baseline against London's Inside Airbnb calendar, though it is whole-household residential, not STR-specific.

name: tako-mcp
what_it_holds: MCP server (hosted, free tier, no key required to start) exposing 'licensed data the open web does not have': company financials, macro indicators, web and app traffic, sports, US government spending. Wraps TakoData's hosted API at tako.so (external host) rather than committing files.
why_useful: Potential machine-pullable route to web/app traffic estimates (gap #5) alongside financials, if the free tier actually covers ABNB/BKNG/EXPE domains — worth a human look at the hosted API's coverage and terms before use, since it is a third-party paid-data reseller behind a free tier, not raw open data.
license: MIT (code wrapper only; underlying data is licensed per repo description)
themes: Retail and ecommerce alt-data open samples (web-scraped prices, Amazon rank), as templates for platform KPI nowcasting
why_all: Potential machine-pullable route to web/app traffic estimates (gap #5) alongside financials, if the free tier actually covers ABNB/BKNG/EXPE domains — worth a human look at the hosted API's coverage and terms before use, since it is a third-party paid-data reseller behind a free tier, not raw open data.

name: price-watch-mcp
what_it_holds: MCP server exposing 'verified SaaS price-change history' and a watch-log, backed by ComparEdge's hosted data (external host, not committed to repo).
why_useful: Not travel/consumer-retail relevant (SaaS pricing only); flagged only as a structural template for point-in-time price-change history capture, which is conceptually close to gap #4 (vintage/point-in-time series) methodology.

name: commerce-apis
what_it_holds: Directory/index repo listing '15,000+ E-commerce and real estate APIs' for product data, pricing, reviews, property listings, market research — a link aggregator, not a dataset itself.
why_useful: Could be useful purely as a discovery index to find a specific retail/real-estate price API later, but it is a link list with no data or working code of its own; low confidence any individual linked API is free or point-in-time.
